prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Transparent anatomical sprite atlas, THREE columns by FOUR rows, all twelve images isolated on true transparency with wide gutters. Reference only for style: luminous cyan contours, translucent coral/violet living cells, muted gold molecules and nerves. No backgrounds, grids, text, panels, circular badges, labels or symbolic icons. Use a consistent local tissue scale across rows1–2: cells about30px across, tiny molecules5–10px across, whole tile about350pxwide. Design images so they can become actual material within skin cross-sections.
Row1 col1: existing red capillary curves horizontally, a small newly growing red tubular branch sprouts upward/right toward a second small capillary; visible endothelial cells and a few red discs, 350x200. Row1 col2: two living spindle-shaped violet fibroblast cells secreting loose coral collagen fibres beside them, tangible tissue material, 300x160. Row1 col3: short strip of violet skin cells at the edge of a gap, older flattened cells above living cuboidal basal cells, two dividing cells, 330x150.
Row2 col1: population of forty tiny amino-acid molecules floating in translucent tissue-fluid volume, small connected atom forms gold/lilac, NOT letter tiles or big balls, 260x150. Row2 col2: same tissue-fluid volume with tiny oxygen pairs, glucose ring molecules, amino-acid molecules and water, 260x150. Row2 col3: many tiny folded violet signaling protein molecules moving from living tissue cells at left toward a red capillary at right, cells and capillary at same scale as row1; no arrows, 350x170.
Row3 col1: small violet enzyme protein cluster cutting golden fibrin threads into short loose fragments; actual folded proteins and actual threads, 200x120. Row3 col2: six slightly irregular worn red blood cells, each 35px wide, one cutaway exposing tiny golden hemoglobin molecules within; no iron filings, 250x160. Row3 col3: two big white recycling cells in spleen tissue, surrounding and engulfing worn red cells of same35px scale, visible membrane/nucleus, 330x200.
Row4 col1: tiny gold iron atoms each bound inside folded violet transport protein molecules, a population within thin pale cyan blood-plasma volume, no red cells, 230x130. Row4 col2: red bone marrow between ivory trabecular bone struts, blood-forming cells at various stages and an intact tiny red vessel carrying newly made red discs, same35px red cells, 350x250. Row4 col3: pair of separated human ears viewed frontally as final-head fitting parts, external coral pinnae, each with small cutaway showing canal, eardrum, ossicles and inner cochlea with semicircular loops, gold nerves exiting medially; ears50pxwide each with gap80px between. No head, no badge.
Transparent background must be clean with no faint white atmospheric wash.
